john_doe (customer): Hi team — trying to apply promo XMASFREE2025 when upgrading from Starter -> Pro via the API, getting rejected as expired. Dashboard still shows it valid until 2025-12-25. Can you help?

maria_support: Sorry about that, john. Can you paste the API request (headers + body) and the exact error you saw? Also send account id or email.

john_doe (customer): account: acct_004812, email: john.doe+prod@gmail.com
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/apply_promo 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"promo_code":"XMASFREE2025","plan":"pro","user_id":"acct_004812"}'

Response: 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "promo_code_invalid_or_expired",
  "reason": "EXPIRED",
  "promo_id": "PRM-2025-XMAS-01"
}

maria_support: Thanks. Reproduced quickly in a sandbox with the same call, seeing same 400. Can you confirm what timezone you're in? (just checking edgecases)

john_doe (customer): I'm in NZ (UTC+13), but the promo page/timezone said midnight PST on Dec 25 so should be long valid.

maria_support: @leif_engineer assigning; seems like either an expiry-math bug or a dashboard/checkout mismatch. I'll put this into billing queue for manual credit until root cause found.

leif_engineer: Looking at the promo metadata: expires_at = "2025-12-25T00:00:00" (stored without tz tag). Our redeem flow treats that as server-local (UTC) in some paths, but the API validation was using end_of_day in customer's local tz for the dashboard. Could be an inclusive/exclusive boundary mismatch.

ashley_billing: @maria_support can you confirm whether we can issue a manual credit for acct_004812 while engineering investigates? This is a paying customer upgrading.

maria_support: Yes — please issue a one-time prorated credit to cover the Pro upgrade and apply the promo equivalent. I'll update the customer once done.

promo-bot: Promo PRM-2025-XMAS-01 metadata snapshot: {"created_by":"marketing","created_at":"2025-11-01T15:23:00Z","expires_at":"2025-12-25T00:00:00","redeem_rules":"one_per_account","time_treatment":"naive"} (logged)

leif_engineer: Quick repro notes for infra:
```
# run validation function used by billing API
python -c "from promos import validate; print(validate('XMASFREE2025','2025-12-25T00:00:00','UTC'))"
# In the path used for API calls we treat expires_at as exclusive (expire at t >= expires_at) while dashboard treats as inclusive (allow same-day).
```

leif_engineer: Root cause hypothesis: mismatch between two validators (billing-api vs console service) around inclusive/exclusive expiry semantics when expires_at is exactly midnight.

maria_support: Ashley, please grant manual credit and flag for refund reversal if bug fix rolls back charge. John, I'll DM you once credit is applied — ETA 30m. Sorry for the friction. :pray:

john_doe (customer): thanks, appreciate the quick help. Will wait for DM.

leif_engineer: Plan: 1) patch billing-api to normalize expires_at to end-of-day UTC for date-only promos OR ensure consistent inclusive/exclusive semantics; 2) add unit test for midnight boundary; 3) run sweep to find other promos with naive midnight times. Creating ticket INF-7623.

maria_support: Ticket INF-7623 created and linked to this thread. Closing the user-facing loop after credit issued.

ashley_billing: Manual credit applied (txn: cr_789102). Noted refund reversal process if needed.

john_doe (customer): received credit, can confirm upgrade worked after re-try. Thanks everyone! :tada:

maria_support: Marking resolved. Will update when engineering patch is deployed to prod.

leif_engineer: Pushed hotfix to staging, will schedule deploy to prod in patch window tonight.

maria_support: Follow-up checklist: update promo docs to specify tz semantics, add dashboard warning when promo expires at 00:00, and notify marketing to avoid midnight-only expirations for future campaigns.

john_doe (customer): great — thanks for the clarity and fast support!
